c.title: $4,000 / 2br - 1400ft2 - LARGE 2 BEDROOM GARDEN SUITE IN HERITAGE HOUSE (KITSILANO)
c.description:
The unit is the bottom floor of a large heritage house in the Shaugnessy area of Vancouver. The house is on a 100 x 125 sq ft lot, and there is a bus route on 16th with easy access to VGH (hospital on 12th ave ) and UBC. It is in walking distance to Kits. Beach and Granville Island with great bike paths to the city center , false creek and most of the time we don’t even use our car to get around.
The unit is about 1,400 sq ft and is a large garden level suite with 2 bedrooms (1 with a king size bed, 1 with a double bed). A large bathroom with 2 sinks and a bath and shower. Living room with a pull out wall murphy bed for guests, large sofa, comfortable chairs and lots of sunlight. The kitchen has a sun roof and looks out to a walk out private patio space , grass and large yard area. There is a ensuite washer and dryer as well as all the appliances needed in the kitchen . If you love doing some gardening there is plenty of room to enjoy being outside and having a space of your own. The suite is totally furnished , including everything for the kitchen utensils, bedding, towels etc and you can arrive with your personal items and settle in and feel right at home. We are looking for a 6 month to 1 year or longer lease. Whether you are relocating from another country or city it’s a great area to start out in and enjoy everything Vancouver has to offer.
